title.value: AI medical coding your coders can verify in seconds.

paragraph.value: Sophus reads each chart, assigns CPT, ICD-10 and HCPCS codes with the evidence behind them, and runs payer edits before the claim goes out. Coders review and approve. Managers see the whole queue.
Coder view: suggested codes with the evidence behind each one. Sample data.
Manager view: team output, review queue and AI coder performance. Sample data.

title.value: Sophus does the first pass on every chart.

paragraph.value: Your coders keep the final say. They check the codes, the evidence and the edits, then approve.
CPT, ICD-10 and HCPCS codes assigned from notes, labs, imaging and operative reports, with pointers, modifiers, POS and units mapped to CMS-1500 and UB-04.

title.value: Shows the evidence for every code

paragraph.value: Each suggestion links to the sentence that supports it and carries a confidence score, so a coder can confirm it at a glance.

title.value: Runs the payer rules before submission

paragraph.value: NCCI, MUE, LCD/NCD and payer-specific edits run on every claim. Anything uncertain is flagged for a coder.
Coding logic tuned to your specialty, from E/M levels to labs, pathology and complex surgical cases.

title.value: Coding time per claim went from 2:30 to 0:32.

paragraph.value: In one Sophus deployment across 50,000+ claims, coders moved from keying codes to checking them. The same team cleared 4.7× the charts.
Average coding time per claim, down from 2:30

title.value: Run the whole coding team from one queue.

paragraph.value: Select unassigned claims and route them to the coder with the lightest load.

Returned claims go back to the coder with the note and the fix.
Every code, edit and approval is logged in HIPAA-secure audit records.

title.value: Built for every seat in the coding workflow.
Approve codes instead of keying them.

paragraph.value: Each claim opens with codes suggested and evidence highlighted. Accept, edit or query the provider, then move to the next chart.
